title: Equestrian Goods
tagline: Saddlery and harness, built for daily use.
blurb: Saddles, harness and tack, hand-finished under our Kingston and Equitel brands for riders and equestrian retailers.
heroIntro: Saddlery is where Kings International started in 1977, and it remains one of our deepest areas of craft. Our saddlers hand-stitch panels, fit hardware, and finish English and continental saddles, harness and tack to the tolerances working riders and equestrian brands expect.
